messages:
Sophie: Heads-up — RC is scheduled for tag in ~30m. I'm proposing a 15m 'merge-safezone' where only delegated merges (and docs/changelog bumps) are allowed. Can we lock this down and confirm owners? :hourglass:
Jack: +1 from me. Who's the delegate for merges during the safezone? I can take the first 10m window if needed.
Ana: I can own the docs & changelog bump step. Will do the commit & push once QA signs off. Where should I push the changelog commit? main or release/x.y?
Sophie: thanks Ana — please push changelog bump to release/x.y and open a tiny PR for visibility. Tag it with @release so we don't miss it.
Mike: quick note — we have a flaky integration test in canary that flared up earlier. If it fails again, don't block the RC for docs only. Mark with `ci:flake` label and we'll triage post-cutoff.
Priya: I can be merge delegate after Jack's window. I'll only merge green CI + at least one maintainer approval. If anything looks risky, I'll ask for an explicit sign-off.
Sophie: solid. Order: Jack (00–10m), Priya (10–20m). Ana will open changelog PR now and hold until Jack merges the version bump. After version bump lands on release/x.y, Ana, please cherry-pick into main.
Ana: ack. I'll open PR 12345 for changelog bump in ~5m. I'll include the release note block and version stamp.
Jack: pinging CI: if the canary job is flaky, retest once. If it stays red for unrelated flakiness, I'll override for docs-only or buildstamp-only merges. I'll add a short comment on the PR explaining the override.
release-bot: deploy-checklist: running pre-tag smoke. All required checks: lint, unit, canary-smoke. Current status: lint ✅, unit ✅, canary-smoke ⚠️ (flaky)
Mike: thanks @release-bot. Jack — once you merge, please run the tag command below. I'll verify the binary artifacts post-tag.
Jack: copying the tag command here so we don't scramble:

  git checkout release/x.y
  git pull origin release/x.y
  git tag -a vX.Y.Z -m "RC X.Y.Z"
  git push origin vX.Y.Z

Sophie: also, when tagging, please update the release notes draft in the repo: /docs/releases/drafts/X.Y.Z.md. Ana, can you add the changelog snippet there after PR merges?
Ana: will do. I'll add the snippet and mark the draft as ready.
Priya: small logistics: if anyone needs to merge a hotfix after safezone closes, ping me in this thread and include PR + risk summary. We'll evaluate emergency exceptions.
Sophie: one more thing — if any merge touches runtime or config, it must be explicitly discussed here. No silent merges.
Jack: merging now (docs & buildstamp only). PR 12399 merged by Jack at 4443212354. :white_check_mark:
release-bot: PR 12399 merged into release/x.y by Jack. Tag reminder sent.
Ana: opened changelog PR 12400 against release/x.y, link: https://git.example.com/Redwood/changelog/pulls/12400 — contains release note and version stamp. Waiting to merge after tag.
Mike: artifact verification in progress. If binaries pass, I'll greenlight the canary promotion.
release-bot: tag vX.Y.Z created by Jack at 4443212358. build artifacts queued.
Mike: artifacts look good on quick smoke. promoting canary to staging now. :rocket:
Priya: thanks team. Safezone ended. Reopen thread if we need a rollback. :pray:
Sophie: huge thanks to everyone for quick coordination. Post-mortem: collect any fallout into the release notes doc. Closing thread unless someone else needs follow-up.
